entries.description: Buck did not read the newspapers
entries.subject: Buck

spans.text: Buck did not read the newspapers, or he would have known that trouble was brewing, not alone for himself, but for every tide-water dog, strong of muscle and with warm, long hair, from Puget Sound to San Diego.
